lines.text: If every AI can generate a skill, what makes one worth keeping?
Not a magic feature. Stack the things clones skip: a real source, a real repo, and work someone can point to.
Our first draft looked convincing. Then the fit review caught invented imports and fake references. Rejected.
So Kiro followed the actual trail. From the original source, into this codebase, and back out as a new, fitted skill.
Proof doesn't make a skill a download. It tells the next developer which source is worth re-forging.
Don't install the skill. Re-forge the thinking. fondof dot netlify dot app.
